---
# Blog post template (decision 0015). Copy to vignettes/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.qmd.
# The leading underscore keeps Quarto from rendering this template as a page.
title: "TITLE — a short, human headline"
date: "YYYY-MM-DD"
# description states the FINDING (one declarative sentence), not the topic;
# shown in the blog index and used for meta description tags.
description: "DESCRIPTION — what the data showed"
# followups feed later investigations and pipeline work; scan with grep across
# vignettes/ to find open threads.
followups:
  - "FOLLOWUP — open question or next analysis"
# Default authorship unless the user says otherwise (project convention).
author:
  - "An AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
# freeze: auto re-executes only when this post's source changes, so committed
# _freeze/ results keep data refreshes from re-running the chunk (dec 0015)
# while deliberate edits still propagate. Never use freeze: true: it serves
# the cached output even after the source is edited, so edits never deploy.
freeze: auto
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{TITLE — a short, human headline}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
```

```{r}
#| label: registry
#| include: false
# Standard: key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide — decision
# 0013). Declare every subject's ids here so the prose below never hard-codes a
# name-based lookup.
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who,          ~cfb_athlete_id, ~gsis_id,
  "Example One", "0000000",       "00-0000000"
)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved YYYY-MM-DD. Careers of recent
classes are right-censored — later seasons may not yet be present.*
:::
